eyebrow: Each type builds on the last

steps.label: ClusterIP
steps.sub: virtual IP, reachable only inside the cluster

steps.label: NodePort
steps.sub: ClusterIP + a fixed port opened on every node

steps.label: LoadBalancer
steps.sub: NodePort + a real cloud load balancer in front

code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  type: ClusterIP   # default, can be omitted
  selector:
    app: payments-api
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
caption: selector matches Pod labels; only reachable from inside the cluster.

eyebrow: NodePort: a fixed port on every node
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: payments-api
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
      nodePort: 30080
caption: <any-node-IP>:30080 now reaches payments-api, wherever its Pods really run.

eyebrow: LoadBalancer: a real public entry point
code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payments-api
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app: payments-api
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
caption: kubectl get svc shows EXTERNAL-IP as <pending> until the cloud LB finishes provisioning.

subtitle: One shared entry point for many Services, instead of one load balancer each.
